|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Galen, Secret Apprentice (V)]]; it is the current text. The image here is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-8-front-master.png]]); the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-D-galenmarekstarkiller-pre.gif]], below) prints the same text. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-04-Galen_Marek_Starkiller.png]]) shows the original text (see [[Galen, Secret Apprentice (V)]]). The alternate-image printing is [[Galen Marek, Starkiller (AI)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Galen, Secret Apprentice (V)]]): printed as “•Galen, Secret Apprentice”, lore (a quotation) “Perhaps you are not as strong as the Emperor thought.”, text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 04)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 04. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Galen's forfeit may not be reduced. Power and defense value +2 while with Fallen Jedi. If defending a battle alone (or defending with Black Leader), may be targeted by Force Lightning. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 4.” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same title and text.<ref name="cl-1240_8-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) retitled the card “•Galen Marek, Starkiller”, removed the lore and changed “with Fallen Jedi” to “with Maris Brood” and “with Black Leader” to “with Juno Eclipse”: “Galen's forfeit may not be reduced. Power and defense value +2 while with Maris Brood. If defending a battle alone (or defending with Juno Eclipse), may be targeted by Force Lightning. Immune to Clash Of Sabers and attrition < 4.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=8, page 8. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image prints the same text.
